summary.text: v1 ships API + CLI only; no standalone public Web UI.

i18n.zh: v1 仅提供 API 与 CLI，不提供独立公共 Web UI。
i18n.en: v1 ships API + CLI only; no standalone public Web UI.

confirmation.confirmation_text: We confirmed we will not ship a standalone Web UI in v1.

rationale.text: Reduces attack surface and keeps the first milestone focused on data-plane reliability.

i18n.zh: 降低攻击面，并使首个里程碑聚焦数据面可靠性。
i18n.en: Reduces attack surface and keeps the first milestone focused on data-plane reliability.

summary.text: Use CBHF folder package form for AI-to-AI handoff of this proposal set.

i18n.zh: 本提案集的 AI 交接采用 CBHF 文件夹包形式。
i18n.en: Use CBHF folder package form for AI-to-AI handoff of this proposal set.

confirmation.confirmation_text: 就按文件夹交接，不要做成单个 JSON 包。

rationale.text: Decision recorded for ContextBridge pilot handoff form.

i18n.zh: 为 ContextBridge 试点记录交接形式决策。
i18n.en: Decision recorded for ContextBridge pilot handoff form.

summary.text: Allow TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 only at the edge terminator.

i18n.zh: 边缘终结仅允许 TLS 1.2 与 TLS 1.3。
i18n.en: Allow TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 only at the edge terminator.

i18n.zh: 与架构概览中的 TLS 事实一致。
